before.source:
version: 2
id: pipeline
name: Pipeline
description: |
  The general-purpose pipeline: refine the request, optionally approve the
  refined brief, plan it, and do the work.
  One canonical stack carries an effort dial on the plan and work blocks
  (low/medium/high). Higher effort raises the lower
  bound on the swarm it plans; the shape is refine → optional human approval
  → plan → work.
launchable: true
presets:
  low:
    name: Low
    description: Fast, focused execution for a well-scoped request.
    overrides:
      plan:
        effort: low
      work:
        effort: low
  medium:
    name: Medium
    description: Balanced planning and execution for ordinary project work.
    overrides:
      plan:
        effort: medium
      work:
        effort: medium
  high:
    name: High
    description: Deeper planning and execution for substantial, decomposable work.
    overrides:
      plan:
        effort: high
      work:
        effort: high

blocks:
  - id: refine
    use: flyt-blocks-judgement:prompt-refiner
    title: Refine the request
    config:
      modelTier: free
  - id: approve-refinement
    use: flyt-blocks-judgement:human-checkpoint
    title: Approve the refined request
    config:
      enabled: true
  - id: plan
    use: flyt-blocks-loop:backlog-plan
    title: Plan
    config:
      modelTier: frontier
      effort: high
      instructions: |
        Decompose the request into the smallest independently-verifiable tasks
        that still carry real meaning. Prefer tasks that can run in parallel
        and say so, and state dependencies explicitly.
  - id: work
    use: flyt-blocks-core:work
    title: Do the work
    config:
      modelTier: standard
      effort: medium
      instructions: |
        Work the plan. If running tests or commands: read every exit code — a
        non-zero exit is a failure to fix and re-run, never a suite reported
        passing while it fails.
